scope: Local synthetic Node CPU workloads only; excludes browser DOM scanning, rendering, network, translation providers and end-to-end user latency.

methodology.order: baseline/current on even rounds; current/baseline on odd rounds
methodology.timing: Synchronous batches without tldts wrappers; matcher setup is outside warm-query/update batches and explicitly reported by separate setup/state-build cases.
methodology.workcount: Separate compiled modules wrap getDomain/parse and delegate to the same actual tldts package; no PSL semantics are mocked. Counts exclude final validation.
methodology.queries: Each decision evaluates extension-disabled and auto-translate predicates as a pair; this is a controlled predicate workload, not an exact browser-event trace.
methodology.limitation: Only domain module has a baseline snapshot; its sole runtime import tldts is identical for both. Same-value update still compares O(N) entries. Index rebuild counts and DOM scans are not inferred from parser counts.

measurementLimits: Synchronous batch elapsed times include OS scheduling; CPU was shared and not exclusive.
Parser work counts are the primary performance evidence.
Timing below the stated floor has no speed ratio; raw samples and regressions in setup/update costs are retained.

lifecycleWorkload.scope: Deterministic runtime-source fixture with injected lifecycle functions and auto rule predicate; counts are not browser DOM timing or provider latency. Bridge DOM event count maps each bridge call to the two dispatched events in the composition root.

resourcePolicyDeviation.action: No repeat of the full matrix solely to relabel resource policy; subsequent runs use explicit concurrency 3 and maxWorkers 1.

browser.inflightCancelEvidenceBoundary: The fixed-delay full-matrix case shows restored DOM but did not record a still-pending local request abort; a separate gated repeat of the same case supplies that evidence.

gatedRepeatOfExistingCase.caseName: disable interrupts slow translation and late reply never reinserts DOM
